summary: This note describes San Giovanni in Conca, a crypt that is the remains of a former basilica church in Milan, northern Italy. The crypt is now located in the centre of Piazza Missori. The note is very brief and gives no further history or details.
one_line: San Giovanni in Conca is a crypt in Milan, northern Italy, remaining from a former basilica church and now located in Piazza Missori.
